record.issue_text: packages/emails/email-manager.ts:541 — newGuests.includes(attendee.email) matching is case-sensitive, so the new-guest vs existing-attendee template choice depends on input casing

adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` the template selection uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`, which is a strict, case-sensitive match. The `addGuests` flow does not normalize email casing before persisting/sending (`guests` from input is passed directly to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` and comparisons like `guest === attendee.email` are also case-sensitive), so differing casing between stored attendee emails and the input can cause the wrong branch (new-guest vs existing-attendee) and thus the wrong email template to be sent.
